# antigravity-priority v1.2.0

## Release Notes

> **Release ready.** All four architecture-deepening workstreams and the complete quality gate are finished for the `v1.2.0` tag.

**Antigravity Priority v1.2.0 brings together core scheduling, quota time-series observability, Host state consistency, and management experience improvements, supported by four architecture-deepening workstreams:**

#### 🏗️ Reliability & Architecture
- **More reliable Host state updates**: Apply, 429 cooldown, and priority reset use consistent state verification and redacted records, making outcomes more accurate and easier to diagnose.
- **Safe quota-probe failure handling**: Only quota obtained successfully in the current round can drive scheduling changes. Temporary probe failures no longer disable credentials, while historical data remains available for display.
- **Consistent Dual Model Group views**: Gemini and Claude/GPT target and predicted results keep clear, stable roles after refresh, probe, reset, and startup.
- **Stronger management-page regression safety**: Overview, History, Diagnostics, Config, and Help are maintained by user feature, strengthening critical interaction coverage while preserving existing workflows.

#### 🚀 Core Features & Enhancements
- **Multi-Dimensional Composite Scheduling & Adaptive Tiering**: Replaced single-ratio urgency with a 4-dimensional composite scoring model: Weekly Pacing Ratio ($P_{\text{weekly}}$, 40%), Absolute Weekly Quota ($R_{\text{7d}}$, 30%), 5h Burst Resilience ($R_{\text{5h}}$, 20%), and 5h Reset Acceleration ($A_{\text{5h}}$, 10%). Solved the issue where accounts with 7% and 73% weekly quota both received priority 100, protecting low-quota accounts while elevating rapid-refreshing accounts.
- **Dual Priority Display (Actual vs. Target/Predicted)**: Credential cards now explicitly distinguish between the host's actual priority and the planned target priority (e.g. `Actual: [Unset] | Target: 100` or `Actual: 100 | Target: 98`), accompanied by an amber `[Pending]` badge or a `[🔮 Predicted]` badge.
- **Time-Series Quota Sampling Dashboard**: Added a `📊 Samples` button on each card, rendering a single table grouped by sampling time that shows the account's Gemini and Claude/GPT quota observations side-by-side with sleek mini progress bars.
- **Immediate Apply Preview with One-Click Confirmation**: Clicking "Apply" now opens a concrete priority change preview modal with a direct "Confirm Apply" button, executing changes immediately without redundant post-apply modals.
- **Scheduler Pause Timer Freezing**: Pausing the scheduler immediately freezes countdown timers and displays "Auto Schedule: Paused" across the dashboard and diagnostics pages.
- **Model Group Sync on Load**: The dashboard model group dropdown automatically syncs with the primary model group configured in the Config Center upon initialization.
- **System Diagnostics Visual Overhaul & 429 Cooldown Monitoring**: Replaced raw JSON code blocks with an intuitive visual dashboard featuring 3 KPI status cards (Scheduler Engine, 429 Circuit Breakers, Last Apply Health), scheduling details with active time window indicators, live countdown badges for cooling down credentials, and desensitized audit streams, alongside a one-click copy of the full redacted diagnostics JSON; unused backend fields were removed.
- **Control Bar Simplification & DryRun Purge**: Removed the redundant "Dry-Run" button from the UI navigation bar, establishing a clean "Fetch Quota $\to$ Live Card Preview $\to$ Apply with Diff Confirmation" workflow; completely purged legacy `DryRun` code and mode branches from the runtime.

#### 🐛 Bug Fixes & Stability
- **Quota Probe Snapshot Generation Fix**: Fixed credentials disappearing after clicking "Fetch Quota", ensuring fresh plan snapshots are generated immediately.
- **Priority Reset State Sync & Apply Guard Unblock**: Fixed stale priority values remaining after reset and removed the frontend guard that blocked immediate apply.
- **Config Center Form Echo & Custom Dropdown State Fix**: Fixed language re-renders overwriting custom dropdown labels and ensured saved dynamic configs persist and echo accurately.
- **Host Credential Sync on Refresh**: The top bar refresh button now actively queries `ListAuthFiles` from the CPA host, immediately picking up newly added or removed credentials.
- **Quota Recovery for Manually Disabled Accounts**: Accounts disabled on the host now retain full quota meter displays and reset countdowns without being mistakenly reactivated, and their status reason reads "Disabled on host".
